name: create_content_import_source
description: Create a content import source (POST /ai/content_import_sources) Declared lifecycle: content_import_sources.status: active → deactivated.

sync_behavior.description: If you intend to create or update External Pages via the API, this should be set to `api`.

status.description: The status of the content import source. Declared lifecycle: active → deactivated.

url.description: The URL of the content import source.

audience_ids.description: The unique identifiers for the audiences to associate with this content import source. Can be a single integer or an array of integers.
